messages.author: 7bbad1eb46b1e6b1
messages.subject: as.Date subtracting a day bug?
parts:
Renjin 0.8.2124
Java 8u60

engine.eval("thisDate<-\"2016-06-1\"");
engine.eval("thisDate2<-as.Date(thisDate,\"%Y-%m-%d\")");
engine.eval( "print(thisDate2)" );


returns: [1] "2016-05-31"

I've tried with various other separators.

Thank you,

Alex
